name: Montesquiu (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the optical centre with the black fortified house of the arms, open and with three white pales.
history: The official flag of Montesquiu is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the black domus of the arms, open and with three white pales, placed at the optical centre so that the figure remains visible when the cloth folds over itself.

features.role: fortified house (domus) with three white pales
